        <maven.compiler.target>21</maven.compiler.target>

    <dependencies>
        <!-- Javalin -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.javalin</groupId>
            <artifactId>javalin</artifactId>

        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.fasterxml.jackson.core</groupId>
            <artifactId>jackson-databind</artifactId>
            <version>${jackson.version}</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.fasterxml.jackson.datatype</groupId>
            <artifactId>jackson-datatype-jsr310</artifactId>
            <version>${jackson.version}</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId>
            <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId>

            <artifactId>slf4j-simple</artifactId>
            <version>${slf4j.version}</version>

            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
            <version>${junit.version}</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.h2database</groupId>
            <artifactId>h2</artifactId>
            <version>${h2.version}</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.13.0</version>
                <configuration>
                    <source>21</source>
                    <target>21</target>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>

                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-shade-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.6.0</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <phase>package</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>shade</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <transformers>
                                <transformer implementation="org.apache.maven.plugins.shade.resource.ManifestResourceTransformer">
                                    <mainClass>com.shop.Main</mainClass>
                                </transformer>

                                    <artifact>*:*</artifact>

                                    </excludes>

                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

input.content:
# Sistema de Gerenciamento de Pedidos - Loja Online

Sistema completo de gerenciamento de pedidos para loja online de roupas e acessórios.

## Requisitos

- Java 21
- PostgreSQL 18 (para produção)
- Maven 3.x

## Compilação

```bash
mvn package
```

Isso irá gerar o JAR standalone em `target/order-service-1.0.0.jar`.

## Execução

### Variáveis de Ambiente

- `PORT`: Porta do servidor (padrão: 8080)
- `DB_URL`: URL do banco PostgreSQL (padrão: jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/shop)
- `DB_USER`: Usuário do banco (padrão: postgres)
- `DB_PASSWORD`: Senha do banco (padrão: postgres)
- `TRANSLOG_URL`: URL da API da TransLog (padrão: http://localhost:8081)

### Iniciar o servidor

```bash
java -jar target/order-service-1.0.0.jar
```

Ou com variáveis customizadas:

```bash
PORT=9000 \
DB_URL=jdbc:postgresql://db.example.com:5432/shop \
DB_USER=myuser \
DB_PASSWORD=mypass \
TRANSLOG_URL=https://api.translog.com \
java -jar target/order-service-1.0.0.jar
```

## API Endpoints

### Checkout

- `POST /checkout/summary` - Calcula o resumo da compra sem criar pedido

### Pedidos

- `POST /orders` - Cria um novo pedido
- `GET /orders/{id}` - Consulta um pedido
- `POST /orders/{id}/payment` - Registra pagamento
- `POST /orders/{id}/shipment` - Registra envio
- `POST /orders/{id}/delivery` - Registra entrega
- `POST /orders/{id}/cancellation` - Cancela pedido

### Produtos

- `GET /products/{sku}` - Consulta produto

### Clientes

- `GET /customers/{cpf}` - Consulta saldo de crédito
- `GET /customers/{cpf}/notifications` - Lista notificações
- `POST /notifications/{id}/read` - Marca notificação como lida

## Funcionalidades Implementadas

### Cálculo de Preços

1. Subtotal dos produtos
2. Desconto do cupom (respeitando limite de 30%)
3. Frete (com integração TransLog)
4. Seguro por região

# Exemplos de Uso da API

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/checkout/summary \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "customer": {
      "cpf": "12345678909",
      "email": "ana@exemplo.com"

    "items": [

    "zipCode": "01310100",

    "coupon": "WELCOME10",

{

  "installments": 1,
  "installmentAmount": 412.07,
  "nextPurchaseCredit": 0.00,
  "gift": false
}
```

```bash

  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "customer": {
      "cpf": "12345678909",
      "email": "ana@exemplo.com"
    },
    "items": [
      {"sku": "CAM-001", "quantity": 2}
    ],
    "zipCode": "01310100",

    "paymentMethod": "PIX",

  }'

**Resposta esperada (201):**
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "status": "AWAITING_PAYMENT",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-18T13:00:00Z",
  "summary": {
    "productsSubtotal": 159.80,
    "couponDiscount": 0.00,
    "shippingCost": 0.00,
    "deliveryDays": 1,
    "insurance": 1.60,

  },
  "items": [

  ],
  "trackingCode": null
}
```

```bash

  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

    "transactionId": "TX-123456",

  }'
```

**Resposta esperada (200):**
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "status": "PAID",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-18T13:00:00Z",
  "summary": { ... },
  "items": [ ... ],
  "trackingCode": null
}
```

```bash

  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "trackingCode": "BR123456789"
  }'
```

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/orders/1/delivery
```

```bash

```

```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/orders/1
```

```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/products/CAM-001
```

**Resposta esperada (200):**

  "weightKg": 0.30,
  "stock": 50,
